reviews.text:
Timezones. This is an amazing app, honestly has made me, my friends, and my family more active. However there is one issue that I see. Timezones. There isn’t an accurate way to calculate scores properly when competing with others in different time zones. For example, the step counter ends at 9pm. Well which 9pm? For myself personally, I compete with my family and friends out East and West. So while EDT/EST finishes at 9pm first due to their time zone, MDT/MST are still able to continue because 9pm EDT/EST is 7pm MDT/MST. Yet when it comes to calculating final scores, it calculates based off of EDT/EST and therefore not calculating all Timezones, because for the group I’m in, those in MDT/MST have two hours to basically changes their scores however that’s not what actually occurs…as the scores calculate at 9pm EDT/EST but those in MDT/MST aren’t alerted as the app tells out countdown that we still have until 9pm MDT/MST.

A friend had a suggestion of being able to create separate groups. So it’s as if you’re tracking your steps across each group, but able to play boosters or actions cards on those in each group. And example would be group 1 and group 2 track your steps but your upgrade earned in group 1 can only be played in group 1. However you can earn an upgrade/action item in each group.

I tried Stompers after hearing people talk about it on X (formerly Twitter, RIP). It makes getting your steps in enjoyable and the design/aesthetic/gameplay is so fun.

I shared it in my family group chat and now we’re all stomping together. The daily game makes us all feel closer, and our group chat is way more active now that someone always has something to brag about (or poke fun).
